# PLAN — iteration 2

## Current state assessment

The verified incumbent uses 95 LUTs and 254 FFs and meets timing (WNS 5.441 ns, WHS 0.134 ns), so promotion requires a strict LUT reduction, or equal LUTs with fewer FFs. Iteration 1’s decoded select-and-mask read mux passed verification and timing but used 136 LUTs, so it was rejected. The current top’s numeric latency is unknown; preserve its observable cycle behavior without adding a numeric latency requirement.

## Hypothesis

Changing the read-data selection to an indexed part-select may let Vivado map the 8:1 mux onto 7-series MUXF resources and reduce LUT use while preserving registered read outputs.

## Instruction for generator

In `axil_rd_if`, replace the in-range `case (araddr[4:2])` assignments to `rdata_reg` with a variable indexed part-select of `regs_flat`, using `araddr[4:2]` to select the same 32-bit register. Keep the existing `araddr[5]` out-of-range SLVERR handling, read acceptance and stall behavior, reset, and registered `rdata` and `rresp`. Do not use the iteration 1 decoded select-and-mask pattern; retain the top interface and verify the complete unit through the fixed integration testbench and routed metric gates.
